title: Q-GAP-durable-agent-runs: An agent run that survives a restart and resumes from its last completed step
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --holds 'file:seed/worker/src/checkpoint.js'
**Prediction:** market_open_gaps <= 3 within 720 h
**Status:** open

Gap in component `operations`: An agent run that survives a restart and resumes from its last completed step. A claimed item whose agent dies part-way is released by reap_claims and started again from the beginning; nothing resumes from the last completed step. Source: doctrine/market.json (MARKET-1). The proof is `file:seed/worker/src/checkpoint.js`, shipped with a test.

**Out of scope:** any other gap in the register, and a proof file with no behaviour and no test behind it.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --holds 'file:seed/worker/src/checkpoint.js'
